summary: This is a routine earnings and dividend announcement 8-K filed by SunCoke Energy, Inc. on April 30, 2026. The company reported first-quarter 2026 financial results and declared a quarterly cash dividend, with no special-situations event such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change. The filing contains only operational updates and a standard dividend declaration, accompanied by safe-harbor language and exhibits including a press release and slide presentation.
